segments.t: Over at Arcobaleno, Elena steps out for twenty minutes and leaves sous-chef Misha in charge, but Viktor uses psychological leverage to take command of the kitchen. Listen to the Russian scene first.
Миша, сделай карбонару, а то я не успеваю.
Дедовщина — это для тех, у кого мозгов нет.
А для гармонично развитых личностей, как я,
Let's break this conversation down line by line.
'I will be back in twenty minutes.' Notice how Russian puts 'will be' and 'minutes' together in a short, direct phrase where word endings show how the ideas connect.
'Misha is in charge.' Here Elena anchors the thought on 'Misha' and finishes on 'main, most important', keeping the spoken rhythm brisk and natural.
'Yes, Chef.' Spoken Russian keeps this brief and expressive, built right around 'chef' without extra helper words.
'Nadenka, please finish making the salad.' Elena uses a polite everyday Russian courtesy expression that sets the tone of the conversation right away.
Миша, сделай карбонару, а то я не успеваю.

'Misha, make the carbonara, otherwise I won't finish in time.' Notice how Russian puts 'Misha' and 'to manage in time, have time' together in a short, direct phrase where word endings show how the ideas connect.
'We will get it done.' Elena centers this short reply on 'to do, to make', letting a few direct words carry the whole meaning.
'Take a seat. Coffee? Thank you.' Chef Barinov uses a polite everyday Russian courtesy expression that sets the tone of the conversation right away.
'So, have you set up senior hazing here?' The past-tense verb ending marks the grammatical gender and number of the subject directly.
Дедовщина — это для тех, у кого мозгов нет.
'Hazing is for people who have no brains.' Notice how Russian puts 'hazing' and 'brain' together in a short, direct phrase where word endings show how the ideas connect.
А для гармонично развитых личностей, как я,
'Whereas for harmoniously developed personalities like me,.' Here Chef Barinov anchors the thought on 'developed' and finishes on 'how / as', keeping the spoken rhythm brisk and natural.
'there are other levers of influence.' In everyday Russian, 'there is' flows straight into 'influence, leverage' without extra linking words.
'Well, we shall see.' Elena centers this short reply on 'we shall see', letting a few direct words carry the whole meaning. Now listen to the full Russian exchange again with everything in place.
Миша, сделай карбонару, а то я не успеваю.
Дедовщина — это для тех, у кого мозгов нет.
А для гармонично развитых личностей, как я,
That finishes Viktor turning the tables on Misha when Elena steps out for twenty minutes. Keep those expressions for taking charge in mind. Until next time!
